node.statement: The multiplication covariance holds. Fix U,V,c,d and put W=u_delta(U bold-dot V), H=h_delta(U bold-dot V). The inverse identity gives U bold-dot V=Pi_delta(W,H)=W bold-dot H. By 1.8, (cU) bold-dot (dV)=(c*d)(U bold-dot V)=((c*d)W) bold-dot H=Pi_delta((c*d)W,H). Both ((c*d)W,H) and the inverse pair (u_delta((cU) bold-dot (dV)),h_delta((cU) bold-dot (dV))) lie in the displayed domain and have the same Pi_delta image. Injectivity of the one displayed diffeomorphism Pi_delta makes the pairs equal, so mu(cU,dV)=u_delta((cU) bold-dot (dV))=(c*d)W=c*d*mu(U,V).
